title: MiniLM L6 MS MARCO cross encoder publisher model card and distribution
evidence_note: English 22.7M-parameter Apache-2.0 relevance scorer. Live API revision 233902d25c440f23af6f7d6e94d2946bac0bee0a; selected onnx/model_quint8_avx2.onnx is 23200716 bytes with advertised LFS SHA256 c80a8b34256ea453093d612e3ac48d3d965a0c0a48c7906709af8b8e28461bf9. Inspected configuration is built-in BERT, length 512, lowercasing tokenizer, no auto_map.
limitation: Publisher ranking benchmarks are not memory-action results; reported throughput uses a V100. Weight availability and license do not establish reproducibility of every training input. No local inference performed as part of this review.
review_level: Model-card usage and benchmark sections; official ONNX listing; live API metadata and small configuration files. No model weights downloaded.

title: Mixedbread xsmall v1 publisher model card and distribution
evidence_note: English 70.8M-parameter Apache-2.0 cross-encoder. Live API revision b5c6e9da73abc3711f593f705371cdbe9e0fe422; onnx/model_quantized.onnx is 87245802 bytes with advertised LFS SHA256 15ef19a6de90be7d52b627f2c784107bd806e64826450f41fb75fa4f0179ab30. Built-in DeBERTa-v2, length 512, case preserved, no auto_map. Quantization config uses per-channel QInt8 weights and reduced range.
limitation: Newer v2 multilingual and long-context marketing does not apply to xsmall v1. Quantized/full-precision ranking equivalence and local CPU compatibility are not established by metadata.
review_level: Model-card usage and benchmark sections; official ONNX listing; live API metadata, model/tokenizer configs and quantization config. No weights downloaded.

title: Qwen3 Reranker 0.6B publisher model card
evidence_note: Apache-2.0 multilingual causal-model reranker with documented 32K sequence length. Official usage reads final-position yes/no logits without generated reasoning.
limitation: Larger than the immediate CPU candidates. Published retrieval benchmarks and context capacity do not establish local latency or correction-sensitive memory accuracy.
review_level: Model-card overview, model table, license and scoring example; official repository scoring code and configuration inspected.

title: Jina reranker v3 publisher model card
evidence_note: Multilingual listwise reranker distributed under CC BY-NC 4.0; illustrates restricted open weights and a distinct listwise approach.
limitation: Noncommercial restriction prevents describing the release as unrestricted open source. Publisher recommendation of a successor is not a verified local performance comparison.
review_level: Model-card architecture summary, current successor notice and license section; no weight or runtime inspection.

title: Sentence Transformers cross encoder inference efficiency documentation
evidence_note: Documents PyTorch, ONNX and OpenVINO backends and hardware/workload-dependent optimization tradeoffs.
limitation: Aggregated backend benchmarks are not speed guarantees for the study hardware, thread count, passage lengths or selected quantized artifacts.
review_level: Backend descriptions, benchmark caveats and recommendation section; no backend benchmark independently rerun.

title: Sentence Transformers retrieve and rerank documentation
evidence_note: Explains candidate retrieval followed by query-passage cross-encoder scoring, with full scoring for small collections and shortlist reranking for larger collections.
limitation: A methodological tutorial, not evidence that a particular shortlist or model achieves complete memory-source recovery. Relevance scoring is not an authority judgment.
review_level: Full short tutorial including pipeline, bi-encoder, cross-encoder and example descriptions.

title: BEIR A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Zero shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models
evidence_note: Comparison across 18 datasets and ten retrieval systems finds BM25 robust and reranking/late interaction strong on average at higher computational cost.
limitation: Benchmarks are heterogeneous information retrieval, not this study's personal-memory action tasks. Average findings do not guarantee a gain on a particular collection.
review_level: Author abstract and publication metadata; not a full-paper or artifact reproduction review.

title: Hybrid Hierarchical Retrieval for Open Domain Question Answering
evidence_note: Combines sparse and dense retrieval at document and passage levels and reports better zero-shot recall than its dense hierarchical baseline; discusses accuracy, latency and storage tradeoffs.
limitation: Document-passage hierarchy and trained QA retrieval differ from folders and workstream routing. No universal optimum for pruning or PARA organization follows.
review_level: Publisher abstract and proceedings metadata; detailed experimental tables and code not independently audited.

title: RAPTOR Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree Organized Retrieval
evidence_note: Constructs a hierarchy with original passages and summaries. Its querying comparison on a 20-document QASPER subset favors collapsed-tree search over layer-by-layer traversal; main experiments use collapsed retrieval.
limitation: Small querying-policy comparison, QA tasks, learned summarization and different context allowances prevent treating this as a universal anti-hierarchy result or proof about personal folder routing.
review_level: Methods and Querying sections, querying comparison description and selected baseline tables; not a full appendix or implementation audit.

title: LongMemEval Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long Term Interactive Memory
evidence_note: Five memory abilities and 500 curated questions; separates indexing, retrieval and reading and proposes granularity/key/time-query improvements. First submitted in 2024, revised and published at ICLR 2025.
limitation: Conversation question answering differs from executable agent workflows; published optimizations do not automatically transfer to filing. The benchmark's authoring and grading require separate assessment before reuse.
review_level: Author abstract, current version and conference metadata; detailed benchmark files and evaluation code not audited here.

title: Question Answering under Temporal Conflict Evaluating and Organizing Evolving Knowledge with LLMs
evidence_note: Temporal snapshots and cumulative news expose outdated/conflicting facts; structured subject-relation-object-timestamp knowledge organization improves the tested ICL/RAG baselines.
limitation: Extraction uses language models; evaluation uses LLM consensus and selected datasets. Improvements do not prove metadata extraction accuracy or a production filing advantage.
review_level: Abstract, dataset and knowledge-organization methods, evaluation setup and selected result tables; code not reproduced.

title: A Hierarchical Consistency Framework for Auditing Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
evidence_note: September 2026 preprint with 100 controlled query-corpus instances across five domains; source-linked conflict inspection distinguishes corpus, retrieved context and answer consistency. Similarity and answer consistency can diverge.
limitation: Controlled study and abstract-level review; does not certify factual truth or show a deployed memory system improves. Full methods and evaluator reliability not independently audited here.
review_level: Author abstract and submission metadata only.

title: SetFit official framework repository
evidence_note: Apache-2.0 prompt-free classification framework combining a Sentence Transformer body with a classifier head; supports few-shot training and multilingual base models.
limitation: Framework license does not replace base-model license. A branch router needs labeled training examples, drift handling and held-out evaluation; sentiment examples do not validate memory routing.
review_level: README overview, license metadata and training example; official quickstart training and inference sections. No training or source-code audit.

title: fastText official classification library repository
evidence_note: MIT-licensed software for text representation and supervised classification; a simple potential branch-label baseline.
limitation: Software and available supervised task models do not provide a ready-made filing router. Branch training labels and language coverage need explicit experimental design; platform compatibility untested here.
review_level: README purpose, usage/resource descriptions and license section; official supervised tutorial overview. No build or training run.

title: Hierarchical Reasoning Model official release
evidence_note: Apache-2.0 release of a small two-timescale recurrent reasoning architecture with puzzle-domain training/evaluation examples.
limitation: Puzzle results do not establish natural-language document retrieval or a pretrained filing router. Applying the architecture would require new representation, training and evaluation.
review_level: README architecture summary, task examples, evaluation instructions and license metadata; no model training or implementation reproduction.

title: Tiny Recursive Models official release
evidence_note: MIT-licensed research implementation of a small recursive reasoning model with trained Sudoku, maze and ARC task settings.
limitation: Small parameter count is not evidence of effective text-memory retrieval or lower end-to-end latency; new retrieval-specific training and simple-baseline comparisons would be necessary. Publisher repository is archived as of the access date.
review_level: README description, task/training examples and license metadata; companion paper abstract for architecture context. No executable reproduction.
